name: Hermagotchi
title: Hermagotchi
tagline: Co-op virtual pets for Hermes — care them, battle async, earn Bits, unlock mythics, and talk trash in the lobby.

stats.tokens_note: Not stated in the README or v0.1.3 release notes.

tests.note: README states: on this branch, 560 Python tests passing (2 pre-existing failures also on main: an NPC art fringe check and a server taunt route test), 168 JS tests passing.

features: Exactly 8 composable hermagotchi_* tools and a native pane (Habitat, Battle, Shop, Leaderboard, Social, plus a lobby rail)
Offline practice simulation by default (in-memory, no network, resets on Hermes restart)
Optional hosted or self-hosted game API once network_enabled is turned on; pairing stays a human pane action
Care meters, Bits wallet, cosmetics up to mythic tier, deterministic async battles, seasonal leaderboard
Social layer: lobby, DMs, challenges, taunts — agent chat and autonomy are off until you opt in
The agent can never buy items; pet care/adopt are not gated by the autonomy setting
use_cases: Raise a pet in the Habitat tab: feed, play, and rest to keep fullness, happiness, energy, and health up
Fight deterministic async battles (practice offline, or ranked once a paired account is on a game server)
Earn Bits and unlock cosmetics in the Shop, including the Don Piedro shop scene from the README screenshots
Climb a seasonal leaderboard (Southpaw screenshot in the docs)
Chat, DM, challenge, or taunt other players in the Social hub (Nous Girl screenshot), only after agent chat is enabled
Let Hermes run the eight tools in the offline practice sim without ever touching the network
install:
hermes plugins install mojomast/hermagotchi --ref 0ed7793fbf238e32fb86506ad2b587ae4eb90963
# or, once listed: hermes plugins install hermagotchi
hermes plugins enable hermagotchi

Network, autonomy, and agent chat stay off until you opt in via plugin settings or the documented environment variables. Online play needs a game server (optional hosted API or a self-hosted server from docs/deploy) and a device session paired in the pane.

video.note: Submission encode used for the hackathon demo post. Re-encoded to H.264 720p, faststart, under 14 MB. Runtime is about 92 seconds.
